A recording carrying `_failure` fails the run with that message instead of finishing, which is how the transcript tab's Retrying state is driven by a fixture rather than by breaking something real. `TranscriptionProviderFailure` is classified retryable by transcription/runner.py, so the row parks at processing/retrying between attempts and reaches failed only after the last one. apps/web/e2e/transcript.spec.ts asserts the retrying state from this recording and stops there; the failed state is asserted from contract-error.whisperx.json, which is terminal on attempt one, so that no test spends three and a half minutes watching a production retry policy tick. Selected by `_durationMs`: it is the duration of apps/web/e2e/fixtures/master-24s.mp4, the synthetic master that has no speech in it and so has nothing to transcribe anyway.
